description: This is a shell script for device-initiated firmware download, including functions for downloading via TFTP/HTTP, updating download status, handling JSON responses from a cloud server, and managing firmware upgrade process based on cloud instructions.

methods.name: updateFWDownloadStatus
methods.description: Updates the firmware download status in a log file with details like protocol, status, failure reason, version, filename, last run time, and update state.

methods.name: getFWVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current firmware version from /version.txt based on specific tags.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Determines whether the build is VBN, PROD, QA, or dev based on firmware version string.

methods.name: sendTLSRequest
methods.description: Performs a curl request to the cloud URL with TLS, checks for HTTP 200 response.

methods.name: tftpDownload
methods.description: Downloads an image file via TFTP protocol.

methods.name: httpDownload
methods.description: Downloads an image file via HTTP protocol.

methods.name: imageDownloadToLocalServer
methods.description: Triggers image download to the local server using specified protocol.

methods.name: invokeImageFlasher
methods.description: Starts the image flashing process using a script or binary.

methods.name: getServURL
methods.description: Determines the server URL for firmware updates based on build type.

methods.name: checkForValidPCIUpgrade
methods.description: Checks if a PCI upgrade is needed based on firmware versions.

methods.name: checkForUpgrades
methods.description: Checks if firmware upgrades are required and triggers them.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Parses JSON response from cloud to extract firmware info and update variables.

methods.name: exitForXconf404response
methods.description: Handles HTTP 404 response from server, logs and exits.

methods.name: createJsonString
methods.description: Creates JSON string with device info for server request.

methods.name: sendXCONFTLSRequest
methods.description: Sends TLS request to XCONF server with retries.

methods.name: sendXCONFRequest
methods.description: Sends XCONF request and processes response.

methods.name: sendJsonRequestToCloud
methods.description: Main function to send JSON request to cloud and process response.
